# Reverse-Engineering
While Caelestinus is able to research their basic gear, the majority of their gear must be acquired through [bold]reverse engineering[/bold].
This is done through the reverse engineering station found on Caelestinus Central.
Items which are [color=gold]reverse-engineerable[/color] can be identified by examining them. They will have a screwdriver icon which can be clicked to reveal more detailed information, including which category they fall under and how many points they contribute when reverse-engineered.
[color=gold]Reverse-engineerable[/color] items can be fed into the [bold]caelestinus reverse engineering station[/bold] in order to progress.
Examining the station and clicking the screwdriver icon will show how many more of each item type you need to unlock the next item.
[color=gray][italic]Reverse-engineerable items which were printed are only valid if they were printed by the correct faction. For example, an Annie or Enforcer must have been printed by a member of the TSFMC in order to be considered reverse engineerable.[/italic][/color]
## Rewards The majority of rewards from reverse-engineering are [bold]unique tech disks[/bold].
These should be placed into Caelestinus' R&D server immediately as they are one of a kind, and unlock new unique recipes for Caelestinus' advanced gear.
